newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-TALLINNA'S ACCOUNT UNFROZEN IN ST PETERSBURG.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-TALLINNA'S ACCOUNT UNFROZEN IN ST PETERSBURG.

text.p: Tallinna Pank said on Friday that the St Petersburg tax inspectorate had ordered the unfreezing of its account in St Petersburg.
"As from this morning, all our correspondent account operations in St Petersburg are normal," Gunnar Okk, board member, told Reuters.
Tallinna Pank sent a delegation to St Petersburg on Thursday to investigate the issue and to hold talks after the St Petersburg tax police froze the correspondent accounts of several Estonian banks.
"The tax inspectorate said that the St Petersburg tax police had no right to block the accounts," Okk added.
"We do not expect any further problems on this," he added.
